Evidence on data.capitol.hawaii.gov: (a) robots.txt (fetch_doc --research check: 'robots.txt permits'; file last-modified 23 Aug 2025) = 'User-Agent: * Allow: /', disallows only *.axd (+ '*.htm$' for SiteimproveBot only). (b) Linking: the data. host serves the WHOLE legislature web app (home page, hrsall, advreports, leginfo, session/slh.aspx, account login) - it is the same site under a second hostname, with relative links that resolve to data.; raw HTML of the home page contains ~30 absolute links, all to www.capitol.hawaii.gov or search.capitol.hawaii.gov, none to data.; hrsall/, advreports/main.aspx, leginfo.aspx, slh.aspx contain no absolute data. links; lrb.hawaii.gov (/, /par/, /constitution/) links only https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov; the legislature's search app JS (search.capitol.hawaii.gov main.2af5da24.js) hard-codes www. 39 times and never data. or /hrscurrent. No 'open data'/'downloads' page names it (FAQ grep: 'daily downloads' are under Reports and Lists on the same app, no data. host). Only evidence of exposure: search engines index data. URLs (WebSearch shows bill PDFs and /hrsarchive/ listings). (c) No statement of purpose found anywhere. VERDICT: it is the publisher's own server, not a third-party mirror, but it is an undocumented alternate hostname of the Cloudflare-protected www site, not a publisher-advertised data endpoint. Using it because www challenges bots is 'an alternate host to get around a refusal' (SCHEMA: never); the same-host exception does not apply (different host, not linked by the publisher). NOT ACCEPTABLE under the policy as written.
